tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 local text file, at most 64 KB.

path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the selected workspace.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write a UTF-8 local text file, creating a backup when replacing an existing file.

path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the selected workspace.

content.description: UTF-8 text, at most 64 KB when encoded.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run a local command with a hard 60-second limit and captured stdout/stderr. On Windows, PowerShell is used unless the command contains CMD-style && or || chaining, which uses CMD. cwd defaults to the selected workspace.

cwd.description: Existing absolute directory or directory relative to the selected workspace.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List up to 200 entries in one local directory.

path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the selected workspace.
